data.name: Main.ProfilePicker.ToolTip
data.comment: Tooltip on the status bar's profile picker.

data.name: Main.PacketCount
data.comment: Status bar: packets received since the engine started. count: a number.

data.name: Main.StationCount
data.comment: Status bar: stations on the map. count: a number.

data.name: Status.Starting
data.comment: Status bar, before the engine has answered.

data.name: Status.Connected
data.value: APRS-IS connected · {server}{verified, select, yes { · verified} other {}}
data.comment: Status bar. server: the APRS-IS server's name, as it reports it (not translated). verified: yes when the server accepted the passcode.

data.name: Status.Connecting
data.comment: Status bar. server: the server being tried, as host:port (not translated).

data.name: Status.Reconnecting
data.comment: Status bar, counting down each second. seconds: a whole number. reason: why the last connection ended, one of the Error.aprs-is texts.

data.name: Status.Reconnecting.Now
data.comment: Status bar, once the countdown reaches zero. reason: as for Status.Reconnecting.

data.name: Status.Refused
data.comment: Status bar; the app doesn't retry by itself. reason: what the server said, in its own words (not translated).

data.name: Status.Details
data.value: {verified, select, yes {Login verified} other {Login not verified: receive-only}} · {reconnects, plural, =0 {no reconnects} one {reconnected once} other {reconnected # times}}
data.comment: The connection's tooltip and a line in About. verified: yes when the server accepted the passcode. reconnects: how many times the connection came back since it first logged in.

data.name: Status.Reconnect
data.comment: Menu item on the connection status: closes the connection and connects again at once.

data.name: Status.Menu
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the connection status button, read before its text.

data.name: Status.NotConfigured
data.value: APRS-IS not set up · add a callsign
data.comment: Status bar before first-run setup.

data.name: Status.Disconnected
data.comment: Status bar.

data.name: Status.EngineUnreachable
data.comment: Status bar when the app can't reach its engine (in the browser: the gateway).

data.name: Error.settings.profile.id-duplicate
data.value: Every profile needs its own id.
data.comment: A program error rather than a user one; keep it short.

data.name: Error.settings.profile.name-duplicate
data.value: There is more than one profile named “{profile}”.
data.comment: profile: the profile's name as the user typed it.

data.name: Error.settings.profile.position-off-globe
data.value: Profile “{profile}”: the location is off the globe.
data.comment: profile: the profile's name.

data.name: Error.settings.profile.position-incomplete
data.value: Profile “{profile}”: a location needs both latitude and longitude.
data.comment: profile: the profile's name.

data.name: Error.settings.active-profile-missing
data.value: The active profile must be one of the profiles.

data.name: Error.settings.invalid
data.value: One of the settings isn't accepted.
data.comment: Shown when the engine rejects a value for a reason this version can't name.

data.name: Error.gateway.settings-read-only
data.value: This gateway's settings can't be changed from the browser: operator sign-in isn't available yet.

data.name: Error.gateway.operator-only
data.value: Only this gateway's operator can do that, and operator sign-in isn't available yet.

data.name: Error.geocoding.refused
data.value: The address lookup server is refusing requests for now. Try again in a minute, or use another way.

data.name: Error.geocoding.superseded
data.value: A newer lookup replaced this one.

data.name: Error.geocoding.unreachable
data.value: Couldn't reach the address lookup server. Check the connection, or use another way.

data.name: Error.geocoding.http-error
data.value: The address lookup server returned an error ({status}). Try again later, or use another way.
data.comment: status: an HTTP status code such as 500.

data.name: Error.geocoding.unreadable
data.value: The address lookup server sent a reply that couldn't be read.

data.name: Error.aprs.callsign-invalid-length
data.value: “{value}” is empty or too long for a callsign.
data.comment: value: what the user typed.

data.name: Error.aprs.callsign-invalid-character
data.value: “{value}” isn't a callsign: character {position} (“{character}”) isn't allowed here.
data.comment: value: what the user typed; position: 1-based; character: the character.

data.name: Error.aprs.callsign-invalid-ssid
data.value: “{value}” has an SSID (the part after the hyphen) that isn't allowed.
data.comment: value: what the user typed. SSID: the suffix after the hyphen.

data.name: Error.aprs.destination-invalid
data.comment: value: the destination callsign.

data.name: Error.aprs.filter-control-character
data.value: The filter can't contain line breaks or control characters.

data.name: Error.aprs.path-entry-invalid-character
data.value: “{value}” isn't a valid path entry: character {position} isn't allowed.
data.comment: value: a digipeater path entry such as WIDE1-1; position: 1-based.

data.name: Error.aprs.path-entry-invalid-length
data.value: “{value}” isn't a valid path entry: it's empty or longer than 9 characters.
data.comment: value: a digipeater path entry such as WIDE1-1.

data.name: Error.aprs.path-too-long
data.value: The path has too many entries.
data.comment: The digipeater path, such as WIDE1-1,WIDE2-1.

data.name: Error.aprs.server-host-empty
data.value: Enter a server name, such as rotate.aprs2.net.

data.name: Error.aprs.server-host-invalid
data.value: “{value}” isn't a server address: use host or host:port.
data.comment: value: what the user typed.

data.name: Error.aprs.server-port-invalid
data.value: “{value}” has a port that isn't a whole number.
data.comment: value: what the user typed, host:port.

data.name: Error.aprs.server-port-out-of-range
data.comment: value: what the user typed, host:port.

data.name: Error.aprs.software-name-invalid
data.value: The app's name can't be sent to APRS-IS. This is a bug; please report it.

data.name: Error.aprs.software-version-invalid
data.value: The app's version can't be sent to APRS-IS. This is a bug; please report it.

data.name: Error.aprs-is.unreachable
data.comment: Why the APRS-IS connection is retrying: the server couldn't be reached or didn't answer the login.

data.name: Error.aprs-is.login-refused
data.comment: reason: what the server said, in its own words (not translated).

data.name: Error.aprs-is.idle
data.comment: The server sent nothing, not even its regular keepalive, for too long.

data.name: Error.maidenhead.empty
data.value: Enter a Maidenhead locator, such as FN31pr.

data.name: Error.maidenhead.wrong-length
data.value: “{value}” has the wrong length: a locator has 4, 6, 8 or 10 characters.
data.comment: value: what the user typed.

data.name: Error.maidenhead.invalid-character
data.value: Character {position} of “{value}” (“{character}”) must be {part, select, field {a letter from A to R} square {a digit} subsquare {a letter from A to X} extended-square {a digit} other {a letter from A to X}}.
data.comment: value: what the user typed; position: 1-based; part: which pair of the locator (keep the keywords field, square… as they are; translate only the text in braces).

data.name: Error.position.off-globe
data.value: That position is off the globe.
